_about: Player notes the data can't show, keyed by ESPN player id or full name: {"contract_year": true|false, "note": "short storyline"}. Kept up to date by the daily analyst task. contract_year feeds the measured 'Contract year' effect; notes are shown on player pages.

Tyler Herro.note: Career-high 50 for Milwaukee in a 3-point loss at Philadelphia; one year left on his deal, no extension.

Brice Sensabaugh.note: 40 points off the bench to snap Utah's 12-game losing streak.

Michael Porter Jr..note: $40.8M expiring deal; Brooklyn listening to calls; shooting slump (1-of-7 vs Chicago).

Draymond Green.note: Elbow; removed from the injury report for Nov 22.

Zach LaVine.note: Trade talk continues; his contract expires after this season.

Giannis Antetokounmpo.note: Questionable for Nov 22 vs OKC with right groin tendinitis; had 27-14-9 against former team Milwaukee.

Jaylen Brown.note: Hamstring; individual workouts only, no timetable.

Kyle Kuzma.note: On an expiring deal; Milwaukee have been trying to trade him since the offseason.

Brandon Ingram.note: Clippers debut expected Nov 23 vs Houston after heel and partial Achilles injuries.

Darryn Peterson.note: Five straight 20-point games for the 1-12 Jazz.

Ja Morant.note: Now with Portland; out with a left hamstring strain, targeting late November or early December.

Anthony Davis.note: 36 and 11 in Washington's win at Chicago; a max extension reportedly unlikely, so he is playing for a new deal.

Domantas Sabonis.note: Reported (Nov 2) to want out of Sacramento; on-court spat with Zach LaVine on Nov 18.

Darius Acuff Jr..note: 21 points in the Kings' first home win, over Boston.

Noah Clowney.note: Started for the absent Michael Porter Jr.; headed to restricted free agency, has struggled with a bench role.

Kevin Durant.note: Faces former team Golden State; within about 900 points of passing Kobe for 4th all-time; taking a career-low 12.3 shots a game.

Kristaps Porzingis.note: Stepped away for his health; Warriors withholding salary and trying to trade him.

Victor Wembanyama.note: 50 points and 19 rebounds vs New Orleans, his second 50-point game this season.

Trae Young.note: Backs Brian Keefe ('it's all of us together'); 13 points after his first scoreless game.

Paul George.note: Scored 36 against his former team, Philadelphia, in a 22-point win.

Karl-Anthony Towns.note: Reportedly motivated by not being extended; called the 4-year, $200M offer unreasonable; can opt out next summer.

Kyrie Irving.note: Back after 19 months out after knee surgery, averaging about 22 points.

Anthony Edwards.note: Out up to two months after knee surgery; the absence threatens the 65-game mark that matters for his supermax eligibility.

Jordan Poole.note: Says he hopes to return to Golden State when his contract runs out after this season.

Kawhi Leonard.note: Knee; Raptors targeting a return around the end of November.

RJ Barrett.note: New hamstring injury; missed Nov 18 vs Washington.

James Harden.note: 51 points vs Indiana, his 26th career 50-point game.

Franz Wagner.note: Game-winner at Brooklyn; averaging over 31 points in his last seven.

Ayo Dosunmu.note: Starting with Edwards out; scored 30 vs Portland.

Cooper Flagg.note: 33 points in the rout of Golden State.

Caleb Wilson.note: Fractured right hand; surgery expected, out about four to six weeks.

Cade Cunningham.note: Probable for Nov 20 after missing one game with right knee soreness.

Zion Williamson.note: Late scratch Nov 21 with a left thigh contusion.

Ty Jerome.note: Upgraded to probable after a hip impingement; averaging about 25 points.

Evan Mobley.note: Sprained right big toe; out at least another 7-10 days (from Nov 16).

Dejounte Murray.note: Requested a trade on Nov 13; a swap for Jalen Green reportedly has zero traction; out with an ankle injury.

Mikal Bridges.note: Hit the buzzer-beating three to beat Portland on Nov 21 after a long slump.

Jalen Green.note: Discussed in a swap for Dejounte Murray that reportedly has zero traction.

Santi Aldama.note: Back from knee surgery; minutes limit lifted, calls it an "in-season training camp".

Lauri Markkanen.note: Out at least a month with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand.

Gary Trent Jr..note: The NBA is investigating whether his Milwaukee deal circumvents the salary cap.

GG Jackson.note: Broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot; needs surgery, no timeline, in his contract year.

Jalen Johnson.note: Broke out of a 3-point slump with 26 points vs Charlotte.

Scottie Barnes.note: 29 points and the go-ahead layup to end Toronto's six-game skid.

Fred VanVleet.note: Back from a torn ACL and starting: 'I'm appreciating every minute.'

Damian Lillard.note: Scored 33 in his first game back in Milwaukee since being waived.

Tyrese Haliburton.note: Hamstring; says he is healing well and targeting a return before December.

Kon Knueppel.note: Re-strained his left hamstring; out at least four more weeks.

Joel Embiid.note: 26 points, 17 rebounds and 9 assists vs Milwaukee on Nov 21.

Paolo Banchero.note: Missed 12 games with a 'complex' ankle sprain; hopes to return in the next few weeks.

Austin Reaves.note: Heel bruise; Redick expects him back Nov 23 vs Utah or Nov 27.

Dylan Harper.note: Left hip strain; out 1-3 weeks (from Nov 19).

Jonathan Kuminga.note: Right shoulder contusion, no timetable; holds a $6.4M player option for 2027.

Mo Bamba.note: 26 points in his first Jazz start; admits the frustration but says the locker room isn't hopeless.

Lu Dort.note: Scored 16 in Atlanta's win at Oklahoma City, his former team.

Walker Kessler.note: Faces his former team Utah again on Nov 23.

Jayson Tatum.note: Rested in the one-point loss at Sacramento, Boston's third straight defeat.

Julius Randle.note: Called the loss to Chicago 'embarrassing'; faces Minnesota, the team that traded him; on the trade block.

CJ McCollum.note: Out at least four weeks with a calf strain; had already lost his starting job to Kingston Flemings.

Deni Avdija.note: Left foot soreness; missed two games, Saturday at New York possible.

Yanic Konan Niederhauser.note: Cleared for his season debut after a Lisfranc fracture.

Brandon Miller.note: Minutes limit after a hip strain; kept out of overtime at the Lakers.

Coby White.note: Minutes limit after a calf strain; kept out of overtime at the Lakers.

Kingston Flemings.note: Back strain; in line for a bigger role with McCollum out.

AJ Dybantsa.note: Career-high 23 and 12 as Washington snapped an eight-game skid.

Alex Caruso.note: Right hip soreness; questionable for Nov 20.

Alperen Sengun.note: Playing in goggles after a scratched cornea; triple-double at Denver.

Jamal Murray.note: Go-ahead step-back in the comeback win over Boston.

Keyonte George.note: 30 points in back-to-back wins over the Clippers and Lakers.

Desmond Bane.note: Franchise-record nine straight games with 3+ threes.

Moritz Wagner.note: Faces Orlando, his former team, and brother Franz for the first time since joining Brooklyn.

Andrew Nembhard.note: Hip; questionable after missing two games.

Sam Merrill.note: Missed two late free throws in the loss to Memphis: 'I feel like I cost the team the game.'

Nic Claxton.note: Now with Chicago; holds 'no ill will' toward the Nets after the rout in Brooklyn.

Trey Murphy III.note: Knee tendinopathy; upgraded to questionable after missing six games.

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander.note: Questionable for Nov 22 at Miami (low back bruise, neck strain) after scoring 40 vs New Orleans; OKC on a back-to-back Monday.

DeMar DeRozan.note: Former Bull returning to Chicago on a one-year deal with Denver.

Luka Doncic.note: Poked in the right eye on Nov 20 ('I'll be fine'); being monitored.

Josh Hart.note: Extension talks tabled: 'I would love to get it done.'

Jerami Grant.note: Left calf strain; out Nov 21, Monday status unclear.

Tyrese Maxey.note: Right foot soreness; late scratch on Nov 18.

Miles McBride.note: Final year of his deal; the Knicks paused extension talks in October.

Derrick White.note: New shoulder issue; questionable after playing all 15 games.

Mitchell Robinson.note: Now a Celtic in a bench role behind Neemias Queta; out ill Nov 21.

Josh Giddey.note: Pulled early in the second half on Nov 20; Splitter criticised his body language. Benched late in two straight games.

T.J. McConnell.note: Ruled out again with the hamstring.

Matas Buzelis.note: Pulled early in the second half on Nov 20 with Giddey; Splitter questioned their body language.

Norman Powell.note: Questionable with a hamstring strain; named an in-season trade candidate.

Pascal Siakam.note: Questionable with a left hip issue.

Nolan Traore.note: Brooklyn's starting point guard left the Nov 20 loss with a hamstring injury.

Cameron Boozer.note: Right ankle sprain; out Nov 21, being evaluated.

De'Aaron Fox.note: Faces his former team Sacramento; only 9 shots in two games since Harper's injury.
